purpose: Held-out command interventions for the stress study's procedural devices, scored against each device's private equations: the output response after each command ends (carried only by stored state), the response during it, the share of the response a model routes through direct command terms, and the output equation's relaxation and drive.
design_basis: Every device was trained on 0-24 time units at 0.25 with no input, pulses of +1 and -1 for 4-5 units, a 12-unit +0.6 pulse and two mixed schedules; validated on +0.8 and -0.6 pulses. The new interventions are shorter, paired, longer, smoother, larger or sustained, and each ends early enough to leave a window for the memory it built, except the step.
control: no input from the shared preparation (z = 0, y = 0), as in the saved held-out records

interventions.name: short_pos
interventions.rationale: 1-unit pulse, a quarter of the training width

interventions.name: short_neg
interventions.rationale: the same pulse with the opposite sign

interventions.name: medium_pos
interventions.rationale: 2-unit pulse at the long training pulse's amplitude

interventions.name: pair_pos
interventions.rationale: two separated pulses: the second lands on memory left by the first

interventions.name: long_neg
interventions.rationale: 10-unit negative pulse, longer than any negative training input

interventions.name: sine_period8
interventions.rationale: one smooth cycle, positive then negative

interventions.name: step_up
interventions.rationale: sustained input: no post-command window; scored during the input only

input_rule: On the 0.25 grid a segment [on, off, a] sets u = a at on <= t <= off and 0 elsewhere; overlapping segments add; between grid points u is linear (a one-sample ramp at each edge). A sine sets u = a sin(2 pi (t - start)/period) for start <= t <= start + cycles period.
windows: Pulse window: from the last zero-input sample before the command to the first zero-input sample after it. Memory window: after that sample to t = 24.

measures.memory: Run minus control output response in the memory window: direction accuracy A, RSE, shape error S.
measures.pulse: The same in the pulse window.
measures.direct_input_share: In the pulse window, the energy of the response of the model's output terms that use the command directly, over that of those terms plus the terms that use a latent state (the true device has no direct term).
measures.split: Models whose output has its own equation: its output-only terms against the true relaxation -d_y y, and its other terms against the true internal drive G(z) = dy/dt + d_y y, as responses over the whole trajectory.

aggregation: Per seed: mean A and S, median RSE over interventions with the window; a failed rollout gives A = 0, S = 1, RSE = inf. Across seeds: median [worst, best].
